STAGE: ideation_1 answer finalised (1 idea, in-scope).
GOAL: one distinct behaviour x hyperbolic coupling for RQ-VAE SIDs, inside the 5-part scope contract, no ablation arm run.
READ: round objective, scope contract, experiment policy, and the failure lists of rounds 125823_958 (fork-angle/barycenter/radial-volume/shell/cone transport), 212003_968 (BRANCHCURV, GEO-SHELL, GEOPFX, GEO_REPAIR, KAPPA_BRANCH, LORENTZ_CONE, SUCC-TAN-RQ, anchored charts), 221240_652 (CURVCELL, SUCCFAN-CURV, cocond-markov-poincare-ot = successor-diffused assignment mass in a Poincare Sinkhorn quantizer).
OBSERVED: every earlier arm puts the curved operation on the assignment (Sinkhorn/voronoi/curvature cells), on transported tangent frames (fork angle, shell, cone), or on anchored charts. None puts it on the CODEBOOK PARAMETER UPDATE driven by the transition graph.
IDEA CHOSEN: SUCC-GEO-CBTAB - behaviour-weighted geodesic triplet margin on prefix-truncated code sums (levels 1,2,L) in a Poincare ball of fixed measured curvature k=1/mean||zhat||^2, gradient into the codebook table only. w_ij = row-max-normalised consecutive-transition count from the training split multiplies the softplus margin violation, so behaviour-off (w=0) gives exactly zero gradient and geometry-off keeps the same term with Euclidean distance. m0^2 (mean random-pair geodesic distance) and k are measured once at epoch 0 and frozen: nothing is tuned, one run, no ablation, no seed repetition.
COST: no extra forward passes; ~6144 Poincare distance evals/step at d=64-128 (<0.5% of a step); 295 KB cache; <1% wall clock over 3000 epochs x 24 steps.
REASONING: leaves encoder, assignment, decoder and Sinkhorn untouched, so it is disjoint from all three earlier rounds' design space, and it targets prefix predictability directly, which is what the generative recommender consumes.
OPEN: whether codebook-only gradient moves SIDs fast enough in 3000 epochs; the geometry-off arm would answer it but is not run this round. Full formatted answer block (IDEA..END IDEA) is the response body of this session.
